summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Line lengths in the new and changed Python files were checked with awk (none over 120). Tests, black, and flake8 were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: items missing "image" or "label" skip resolution instead of raising; items are shallow-copied; the loader also raises ValueError when the top-level JSON is not an object or the key's value is not a list; the test module has no list-valued path case.
